## What's new

- Settings that turn on and off are drawn as a switch instead of the word On or Off: Shader, Rewind, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and the shader settings that are on or off, like Glare and Sheen.
- Settings that go through a list of choices or step a number (Display Mode, Sort By, Overlay, Style, Game System, UI Theme, Menu Color, Audio Output, every shader number and more) show a small arrow on each side of the value when the cursor is on them.
- A row with › still opens another page, and the Shader row has both: a switch, and › to open its settings.

---

ChaOS 0.12.1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.12.1-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.12.1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
